text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 alert — GPU memory pressure detected in pool 'ark-03' (us-west2). Trigger: repeated cudaMalloc failures and NVML OOM events. Link: https://pd.redwood.example/PD12345
pagerduty: Alert details: PD12345 · started 2026-03-17T02:14Z · impacted service: inference-hosting · affected nodes: pool-ark-03[node-ark-03, node-ark-07] · symptom: cuda-malloc failure spikes · suggested runbook: evacuate node / fallback routing
ji: ACK — taking initial triage. grabbing logs and checking which customers hit 5xx.
lia: I see a spike in batch sizes for the rerank route around the same time, 95p latency jumps and many OOM traces. can we confirm fallback routing is enabled?
samir: quick check from metrics: ~4 customers showing 503s and increased retry rate (cust-42, cust-77, cust-99, cust-120). starting mitigation: enable low-memory model variant for rerank.
ops-shift: @ji noted. I'll start node evacuation for node-ark-03. will cordon then drain.
ji: running commands to cordon and drain heavy pods — paste below.
ji: ```sh
kubectl cordon node/node-ark-03
kubectl drain node/node-ark-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force\```
ops-shift: evacuation initiated. moving ~12 replicas off node-ark-03, ETA ~3m. watching reschedule failures.
lia: applied throttling rule for client-tier-high: reduce max batch size 16 -> 8 and cap inflight tokens. should reduce mem pressure for pending requests.
samir: observed worker log: "[worker-72] ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory at allocator.cu:412" also NVML shows memory oscillation on node-ark-03 (peak 98%).
ji: enabling temporary model fallback policy for critical traffic: rtr-1.2 -> rtr-1.2-quant8; non-critical -> cpu fallback. routing change pushed.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 acknowledged by ji (2026-03-17T02:16Z)
ops-shift: drain finished; node cordoned; pods rescheduled to pool-ark-04 and pool-ark-05. no restart loops observed.
lia: metrics trending down: OOM log count -> 0 in last 2m, 95p latency decreasing. request success rate recovering.
samir: customer impact summary: 4 customers saw transient 503s lasting ~45–120s (depends on retry). Support notified with ticket refs. blast radius small.
ji: handing off active monitoring and RCA to @ops-shift — I'm out for scheduled downtime. I'll open an incident ticket and attach logs/snapshots. tagging @oncall-secondary for follow-up.
ops-shift: ack handoff. will monitor for 30m and run memory-heap traces (heaptrack/neural-kv dumps). will also schedule node hardware checks. creating incident summary: INC-20260317-01.
cicero: note — consider decreasing default rerank batch size or enable adaptive batching when pool mem > 80% to avoid future pressure.
ji: leaving channel, thanks all :zzz: 
ops-shift: monitoring window started. will update when stable for 30m, then resolve PD.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 resolved by ops-shift (2026-03-17T02:25Z)
